title: iNeuron RNA Extraction and RT-qPCR
author: Benjamin O'Callaghan
materials: 100ng of RNA is reverse transcribed in a 10 µL reaction with 2.5 U/µl SuperScript IV reverse transcriptase, 2.5 micromolar (µM) random hexamers, 0.5 millimolar (mM) dNTPs, 5 millimolar (mM) DTT and 2 U/µl RNAseOUT. A 100ng reverse transcription negative control reaction consisting of the same reaction mixture above but without reverse transcriptase is also conducted for each sample. The reverse transcription and negative control reactions are thermocycled at: Temperature Time Cycles 1 25°C 10min x1 2 50°C 40min 3 80°C 10min Reverse Transcription Thermocycle

steps.title: Extract total RNA with Monarch kit
steps.instruction: Isolate RNA from iNeuron cultures using the Monarch Total RNA Miniprep Kit (New England Bioscience) following the manufacturer’s protocol, including the gDNA binding column and the optional on‑column DNase treatment, then elute the RNA in 30 µL nuclease‑free H₂O.

substeps.instruction: Follow the Monarch kit instructions for cell lysis and binding.
Insert the gDNA binding column during the purification.
Apply the optional on‑column DNase treatment as directed.
Elute the purified RNA in 30 µL nuclease‑free H₂O.

steps.title: Quantify RNA using NanoDrop
steps.instruction: Measure RNA concentration and purity by recording the 260 nm absorbance on a NanoDrop One Spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Dilute cDNA to 0.83 ng/µL
steps.instruction: Dilute the reverse‑transcribed cDNA (and the RT‑negative control) so that 100 ng of cDNA is present in a final volume of 120 µL, yielding a concentration of 0.83 ng/µL.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 µL of the cDNA reaction to 110 µL nuclease‑free H₂O.
Mix gently; the resulting solution contains 100 ng cDNA in 120 µL (0.83 ng/µL).

steps.title: Set up RT‑qPCR reactions
steps.instruction: Prepare 10 µL RT‑qPCR wells using 3.33 ng of diluted cDNA (4 µL of the 0.83 ng/µL dilution), Power SYBR Green PCR master mix, 500 nM gene‑specific primer pairs, and run on the QuantStudio 7 Flex Real‑Time PCR System with technical replicates and RT‑negative controls.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 4 µL of the diluted cDNA (3.33 ng) into each well.
Add Power SYBR Green master mix to reach a total volume of 10 µL.
Include gene‑specific primers at a final concentration of 500 nM each (PINK1_F: GTGGAACATCTCGGCAGGTT, PINK1_R: CCTCTCTTGGATTTTCTGTAAGTGAC, UBC_F: CTGGAAGATGGTCGTACCCTG, UBC_R: GGTCTTGCCAGTGAGTGTCT).
Set up at least two technical replicates per sample/target.
For each gene target, include a well with the same volume of RT‑negative control.
Seal the plate and run the program on the QuantStudio 7 Flex.

steps.title: Analyze Ct values and calculate expression
steps.instruction: Use QuantStudio Real‑time PCR Software to obtain Ct values automatically, then compute relative PINK1 mRNA expression using the 2⁻ΔΔCt method with UBC as the housekeeping gene.

substeps.instruction: Import the run data into QuantStudio software and let it determine Ct values.
Apply the 2⁻ΔΔCt calculation, normalizing PINK1 Ct to UBC Ct for each sample.
